scope: Post-confirmation same-trajectory checkpoint diagnostic on the registered 2.0-second RAVDESS raster target; no new registered gate.
question: Within each fresh 80-epoch training trajectory, does validation selection after the old 40-epoch cap change the same-target confirmation MAE or the constant-minus-aligned ordering?
analysis: For each seed and condition, retain the best validation checkpoint at or before epoch 40 from one continued 80-epoch trajectory and its final validation-selected checkpoint. Score both on the same 240 already-opened confirmation clips. Report per-seed and per-actor before/after differences, selected epochs, early stopping, and whether the cross-condition ordering changes. This isolates checkpoint selection within each trajectory, not the effect of retraining with a new random trajectory or a prospective population estimate.
